title: Signature: Checkpoint quorum
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): checkpoints are written to three independent stores, and resume requires at least two of the three to agree. A single corrupted or compromised store cannot poison recovery. Disagreement triggers a quarantine of the outlier and an integrity alert. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers writing each checkpoint to three stores.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 3, 2: 5, 3: 7}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import hashlib
def h(s): return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
stores = [{"n": N, "data": [h("row%d" % i) for i in range(N)]} for _ in range(3)]
stores[2]["data"][1] = "deadbeef"  # one store corrupted
votes = {}
for s in stores:
    key = tuple(s["data"]); votes[key] = votes.get(key, 0) + 1
winner, count = max(votes.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
print("stores:", len(stores), "| majority agreement:", count, "of", len(stores), "| quorum reached:", count >= 2)

title: Signature: Time-travel resume
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): resume is not limited to the latest checkpoint. Any earlier checkpoint can be selected, so a job can roll back past a bad input or a poisoned step and continue from a known-good point. Each checkpoint carries its step number and a human-readable label. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers addressing checkpoints by step number and label.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 5, 2: 8, 3: 12}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
ckpts = [{"step": i, "label": "step-%d" % i, "total": sum(range(i + 1))} for i in range(N)]
poisoned_at = N - 2
target = poisoned_at - 1  # roll back before the poisoned step
chosen = ckpts[target]
print("checkpoints:", N, "| poisoned at step", poisoned_at, "| resumed from:", chosen["label"], "total =", chosen["total"])
